### Planning Intelligence Log

- Gap analysis (Step 1): all user-named artifacts covered (check-hermeticity.sh, check-known-antipatterns.sh, check-config-key-docs.sh, check-pipefail-grep.sh, known-antipatterns.yaml, .pre-commit-config.yaml, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, dso-config.conf all map to SCs).
  - Parts executed: all parts (Part A artifact contradiction check; Part B technical self-review + inference-signal scan — no unverified inferred sources; Part C shared-artifact impact in behavioral-prohibition mode — existing ~63 SIGPIPE / ~24 declare -A / unbound-CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT sites covered_by_SC via the SC2 baseline mechanism).
- Web research (Step 2.6): not triggered.
  - Bright-line conditions that fired: none (no third-party API, no new dependency — yq/python3 already present, no novel architecture; extends the existing hook idiom). Prior art noted for implementation: detect-secrets .secrets.baseline, betterer, plus the in-codebase SIGPIPE remediation precedent.
- Scenario analysis (Step 2.75): triggered (full mode, 8 SCs >= 5).
  - Scenarios surviving blue team filter: 9 (3 high runtime/deployment, 1 high parser-divergence, 3 medium config, 2 assumption — rename enumeration and lib bash-3.2 self-compat).
- Practitioner-requested additional cycles: none.
- Follow-on scrutiny (Step 0): not triggered.
- Feasibility resolution (Step 2.5): not triggered (no external integration or first-time internal platform feature; feasibility reviewer not dispatched).
- LLM-instruction signal (Step 5): not triggered (mechanical bash hooks with developer-facing diagnostics; no SKILL.md / agent prompt / prompt template / LLM-facing instruction text).
- Scale context (Step 0): small scale (default) — local pre-commit hooks; no volume-sensitive decision.
- Cross-epic interaction scan (Step 2.25): 133 candidates, 27 haiku batches dispatched (STATUS=ok, MAX_AGENTS=unlimited). Signals: 0 conflict, 0 ambiguity, 8 consideration (registry consumers 99f1-153c/d63f-2c74/a47f-b451; pre-commit hook-ordering cluster 230a-344a/bc7f-1a0d/af26-dd5a/c337-ed61/857d-a35a), remainder benign (disjoint CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md / .pre-commit-config.yaml sections). Injected two consolidated Cross-Epic Interaction ACs (registry-schema-publish-first; merge-safe discrete hook entries). relates_to links created: a47f-b451, bc7f-1a0d (d63f-2c74 link skipped — tracker rejected as epic-level cycle; relationship captured in Cross-Epic Interactions).
- Fidelity review (Step 3): all three core reviewers passed (Agent Clarity self_contained 4 / success_measurable 4; Scope right_sized 5 / no_overlap 4 / dependency_aware 5 / consumer_completeness 5; Value user_impact 5 / validation_signal 5). 0 revision cycles. Two minor findings folded into SC2/SC4 wording and the Dependencies scope-boundary sentence. Architectural probe (class:architectural) ran with non-empty output.
- Spec evolution: started from the 6 proposed SCs; refined SC2/SC4/SC5/SC6 per scenario + fidelity findings; added SC7 (rename/mode-change enumeration) and SC8 (lib bash-3.2 self-compatibility) at practitioner direction. Final count 8 (SC delta +2 = at, not over, the >2 structural-re-review threshold; no scope migration — passing scores retained).
